name: list_invoices
title: List invoices
description:
List and search invoices with optional filters for status, payment state, client, and more.

    Supports filtering by invoice status (draft/issued/void), payment status (unpaid/paid/overdue/partial),
    client, and archive state. Returns invoice number, client name, total, balance due, status, and due date.
    Use payment_status="overdue" (with order_by="due_date") to answer "who owes me?" / "what's overdue?".
    Responses include record ids; response_format='concise' returns trimmed rows (ids kept), 'detailed' adds links and secondary fields.

response_format.title: Response Format
response_format.description: 'detailed' (default) matches today's full output, including links and secondary fields. 'concise' trims each row to essentials but always keeps '[id: ...]' for follow-up view/write tools.

name: view_invoice
title: View invoice
description:
View a specific invoice with full details including line items, payments, and totals.

    `identifier` accepts an invoice number (e.g., INV-001) or a UUID — the tool resolves
    either form. Returns complete invoice data including client info, line items, payment
    history, and status. In ChatGPT, renders an interactive invoice card.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: Invoice number (e.g. INV-001) or invoice UUID. The tool resolves either form.

name: list_clients
title: List clients
description:
Search clients by name (fuzzy matching — 'acme' finds 'Acme Corp').

    Also searches contact names linked to clients — so searching 'Brandon Chu' will find
    a client named 'Brandon' if it has a contact named 'Brandon Chu'.

    Returns client name, email, and status. Use include_contacts=true for contact details.
    Always search before creating a new client to avoid duplicates.
    Responses include record ids; response_format='concise' returns trimmed rows (ids kept), 'detailed' adds links and secondary fields.

response_format.title: Response Format
response_format.description: 'detailed' (default) matches today's full output, including links and secondary fields. 'concise' trims each row to essentials but always keeps '[id: ...]' for follow-up view/write tools.

name: list_contacts
title: List contacts
description: List contacts, optionally filtered by client. Shows name, email, phone, and role.

name: create_invoice
title: Create invoice
description:
Create a new invoice with line items. Auto-generates invoice number and public URL.

    BEFORE CALLING: Use business_settings to get default currency and tax rate.
    Use list_services to find service IDs if linking line items to existing services.
    Use list_clients to find the client_id by name.

    Currency defaults to the business's configured currency if omitted.
    Due date defaults to 30 days from today if omitted.
    To apply tax, set sales_tax_applied on each line item (e.g. 0.13 for 13% HST).

LineItem.description: A line item for an invoice or proposal.

description.description: Description of the work or item
description.title: Description

service_id.description: Service ID from list_services (links to existing service)
service_id.title: Service Id

discount_applied.description: Discount amount. With discount_type='percentage' use 0-100. With discount_type='fixed' use a positive amount in the invoice currency.
discount_applied.title: Discount Applied

sales_tax_applied.description: Tax rate as decimal (e.g. 0.13 for 13%). Get default from business_settings.
sales_tax_applied.title: Sales Tax Applied

LineItem.title: LineItem

client_id.title: Client Id
client_id.description: Client UUID returned by list_clients. Search by name first if needed.

line_items.title: Line Items
line_items.description: Invoice line items with description, quantity, unit_price, and optional tax/discount fields.

due_date.title: Due Date
due_date.description: Optional due date. Defaults to 30 days from today.

issue_date.title: Issue Date
issue_date.description: Optional issue date. Defaults to today.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency code such as USD or CAD. Defaults to business_settings currency.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Optional customer-facing notes printed on the invoice.

is_online_payment_enabled.title: Is Online Payment Enabled
is_online_payment_enabled.description: Whether to enable online payment for this invoice when available.

name: list_deals
title: List deals
description:
List pipeline deals.

    Defaults to live deals only: approved deals assigned to a pipeline stage.
    Set review_state to pending, dismissed, approved, or all to inspect other
    review states. Use search for target name or company text.
    Responses include record ids; response_format='concise' returns trimmed rows (ids kept), 'detailed' adds links and secondary fields.
    In ChatGPT, renders an interactive pipeline board grouped by stage.

response_format.title: Response Format
response_format.description: 'detailed' (default) matches today's full output, including links and secondary fields. 'concise' trims each row to essentials but always keeps '[id: ...]' for follow-up view/write tools.

name: get_pipeline_summary
title: Get pipeline summary
description:
Summarize active deal counts, linked value by stage, and pending-review count.

    In ChatGPT, renders an interactive pipeline board grouped by stage.

name: move_deal_stage
title: Move deal stage
description:
Move a deal to Lead, Opportunity, Won, or Lost.

    This is an operator/manual move and allows corrections such as moving out
    of Won/Lost. Moving to Won requires the deal to already be linked to a
    client; if not, the tool returns the client-resolution requirement.

name: send_invoice
title: Send invoice
description:
Send an invoice via email to the client. Sets invoice status to 'issued'.

    IMPORTANT: Only call this when the user explicitly asks to send/email the invoice.
    Do NOT auto-send after creating — invoices are created as drafts for review first.
    This sends a real email to the client's contact email address.

name: ask_assistant
title: Ask assistant
description:
Read-only Q&A fallback. Use a specific tool first; reach for this only when no other tool fits.

    PREFER specific tools whenever the request maps to one:
    - Listing/filtering: list_invoices, list_clients, list_proposals, list_payments, list_expenses, list_services, list_contacts, list_deals, list_prospects, get_pipeline_summary
    - Lookup by id/number/name: view_invoice, view_client, view_proposal, view_deal, view_prospect
    - Read-only summaries: network_summary, get_daily_brief, get_heartbeat_summary, get_financial_report
    - Mutations: create_invoice, create_proposal, create_client, create_contact, record_payment, send_invoice, create_deal, move_deal_stage, log_deal_activity, etc.
    - Capability/help: what_every_does for "what can Every do?", get_home for onboarding/welcome.

    USE THIS TOOL ONLY for analytical questions that span multiple data points and have no
    direct tool — e.g. "what's my revenue this quarter?", "which clients have the most
    overdue invoices?", "summarize my pipeline this month". It is read-only: writes,
    drafts, sends, deletes, and external MCP actions are refused. For changes, use the
    specific write tools (create_invoice, record_payment, send_invoice, create_deal,
    move_deal_stage, log_deal_activity, etc.).

    Simple questions answer in seconds on a warm conversation; complex analytical
    questions can take a minute or more, so keep first questions focused. Follow-up
    questions asked within about 30 minutes reuse the same conversation thread, so you
    can ask naturally without repeating earlier context.

message.title: Message
message.description: Fallback question for analysis that spans multiple data points (e.g. revenue, pipeline summaries, cross-entity rollups). Prefer specific tools — list_*, view_*, create_*, what_every_does, get_home — when one fits the request.
